title: Bounded Site create, update and delete writes
opportunity: Site create, update and delete persistence calls still passed the request token directly to PostgreSQL after validation and lock acquisition.
rootCause: A slow transaction could hold an interactive Multi-Site mutation without a bounded write response, and the browser had no localized recovery copy for this distinct failure.
implementation: Added a two-second linked SiteMutationWriteBudget with explicit client-cancellation distinction.
Applied it to InsertAsync, UpdateWithConcurrencyAsync and DeleteWithConcurrencyAsync while retaining the existing mutation lock, validation-read budget and activation token boundaries.
Returned site_mutation_write_timeout and added localized Thai recovery copy.

tdd.red: SiteMutationWriteBudgetTests initially failed to compile because the write budget policy did not exist; the endpoint contract then required all three mutation endpoints to use it.

verification.impeccableDetector: 0 anti-patterns; four pre-existing advisory design-system-color findings in app.js (#ff4d5e, #22374f, #ff6378); no new finding

boundaries: Live PostgreSQL slow-write execution, authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive verification, full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified.
